$comment: Third-party components that Esses packages ship (D-212; 08 sections 7.4 and 9). tools/packaging/gen_third_party.py writes THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md and the CycloneDX SBOM of a package from this list, the licence files named here and the files found in the package; its --check keeps this list, NOTICES.md and third_party/ in step. A version 'from the build' is filled from the package (Qt's from the build, the C++ runtime's from the redistributable shipped). packages: the packages that contain the component (app: the application package, cli: the standalone command-line tool); os: limits it to some packages' operating systems.

components.name: Qt
components.copyright: The Qt Company Ltd. and other contributors
components.use: Qt Core, Qt Gui and Qt Widgets, and Qt Svg for the SVG image-format and icon-engine plugins, with their platform, style, image-format and icon-engine plugins, linked dynamically and unmodified (D-006); deployed by windeployqt, macdeployqt or linuxdeploy. Qt contains third-party code under its own licences, listed at https://doc.qt.io/qt-6/licenses-used-in-qt.html and in the qt_attribution.json files of the source archive.

components.name: Qt Advanced Docking System
components.copyright: 2017-2026 Uwe Kindler and the Qt Advanced Docking System contributors
components.use: the dock windows of esses (the default DockHost backend), built from third_party/qtads (the upstream tag with the changes listed in third_party/qtads/UPSTREAM.md) as a separate shared library beside esses (D-026, D-153).

components.name: pugixml
components.use: reading the XML sidecar files of logs (esses_formats), compiled into every program.

components.name: xxHash
components.use: content hashes (esses_base Hash128), compiled into every program.

components.name: nlohmann/json
components.use: every JSON document, compiled into every program.

components.name: json-schema-validator
components.use: validating documents against their schemas (esses_project, esses-cli validate).

components.name: CLI11
components.copyright: 2017-2024 University of Cincinnati, developed by Henry Schreiner

components.name: fast_float
components.use: number parsing (esses_formats); used under its MIT option.

components.name: Microsoft Visual C++ Redistributable
components.licenceName: Microsoft Software License Terms for Visual Studio, Distributable Code
components.use: the C++ runtime of the Windows programs: the installer runs the bundled vc_redist.x64.exe when the installed runtime is older than the build's (or, for a per-user install, puts its DLLs beside esses.exe); the portable zip and the command-line zip carry its DLLs beside the programs (app-local deployment, which the Distributable Code terms allow).
